text:
tori: quick questionSOC needs a scoped export of auth+proxy logs for a fast vuln triage. they asked for 14d of events but only need raw for the first 48h. thinking: export narrow window (48h raw), store scrubbed 14d-derived artifacts, ephemeral CMK unwrap via kms-proxy, and a short-lived service role. ok?

sam: agree on principle. we must avoid granting Decrypt to humans. kms-proxy only. what about lifecycle and accidental retention?

tori: plan: 1) infra generates raw snapshot -> encrypted with customer CMK envelope -> placed in s3://sec-temp/<ticket>/raw/ 2) scrubber runs -> produces scrubbed copy in /scrubbed/ 3) raw auto-delete TTL=72h, bucket lifecycle enforce + object-lock?

ben: object-lock probably overkill for short TTL but ensure we have immutable audit trail. require explicit delete job that logs deletion with ticket id.

infra-bot: note: export job requires fields: ticket_id, requester, justification, from, to, retention_hours, approver. Missing fields will reject.

sam: RBAC: propose two roles: `siem_snapshot_requester` (can open ticket, no raw read) and `siem_snapshot_operator` (infra team, can run export CLI). `kms-proxy` service principal has kms:Decrypt with condition on `kms:RequestTag/ticket`. humans never get kms:Decrypt.

tori: yea, and require `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true` for `siem_snapshot_operator` in prod. also deny s3:GetObject on raw path except to kms-proxy principal.

ben: small nit: how enforce kms tag equality? sample policy snippet?

sam: paste below. pls review.

sam: ```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"kms:RequestTag/ticket": "${aws:RequestTag/ticket}"}
  },
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-proxy"}
}
```

tori: looks good. also attach a condition that the request includes `ticket` and `expiry` tags.

ben: procedural ask: require sec-lead or oncall approval recorded in ticket metadata before export job runs. infra-run should validate approval via ticket API.

infra-bot: reminder: add `post_export_assertion` step. We run `scrubber --assert` and emit a signed attest artifact stored at s3://sec-temp/<ticket>/attest/sha256.txt.sig. If scrub fails, revoke access and rotate the temp CMK.

tori: good. also add a short retention window for attest artifacts (30d) and keep audit log forever.

sam: one more guard: if snapshot spans >7d of raw events we require sec-approval + legal signoff. helps with egress risk.

ben: logging: every action (create ticket, approve, export start, kms unwrap, delete raw) must be logged to centralized audit sink with fields: ticket, actor, ip, tool, sha256(object). Make sure logs are tamper-evident.

sec-lead: I approve the flow in principle. two conditions: 1) add a forced scrub checklist for PII-sensitive services, 2) require PR with new IAM role definitions and terraform changes. once PR exists tag me.

tori: will do. I'll open PR with role defs, sample IAM policy, bucket lifecycle, and runbook steps. linking back when ready.

sam: also add a console link in ticket UI to view snapshot audit (read-only) and the scrub attest. avoids emailing credentials.

ben: thanks. i'll draft the RBAC PR + runbook. ping @sec-lead when it's ready. :+1:

tori: thanks all. closing thread unless objections.
